ease.name: Ease (%)
ease.help: This controls the amount of ease. Since this is a pattern for leggings that is normally made of stretch fabric, the ease is negative, meaning the fabric is stretched around the body.

waistreduction.name: Waist circumference reduction (%)
waistreduction.help: The amount by which the waist should be reduced. This is a percentage of the waist circumference. Only available when the waistband option is selected. Look in the Messages from the designer for the exact size.

waistband.name: Waistband
waistband.help: Add a separate waistband to the design.

lowerwaistbandback.name: Waistband Lowering
lowerwaistbandback.help: Lower the waistband in the back.

length.name: Leg length (%)
length.help: The length of the legs. Look in the Messages from the designer for the exact length.

waistbandsize.name: Waistband size (%)
waistbandsize.help: Size (height) of the waistband. This is a percentage of the Waist-To-Hips measurement.

waistlowering.name: Waist lowering (%)
waistlowering.help: Lowering of the waist. This is a percentage of the Waist-To-Hips measurement.

sidepanel.name: Side Panel size (%)
sidepanel.help: Size (width) of the side panel. This is a percentage of the waist circumference.

pocketdepth.name: Pocket depth (%)
pocketdepth.help: Depth (height) of the pocket. This is a percentage of the Waist-To-Seat measurement.

smoothing.name: Smoothing (%)
smoothing.help: This setting controls the amount of smoothing that is done to create the side seams (and overall shape of the leggings).
